opening.argument: The materials present a Bitcoin program that links a $1 entry to an advertised $810,000 outcome and directs viewers to join through a shortened URL. The title states “Just $1 in Bitcoin and make $810,000 in Bitcoin,” while the description instructs viewers to “Turn $1 into $810000 in BTC.” Its staged, level-based structure describes larger returns through upgrades and sponsor matching, including a level that “Pays out $16,200” with “a 100% Match to sponsor.” The materials also state that “Those who sponsor, will become RICH,” and encourage a one-time donation followed by sharing as fast as possible. The records do not establish whether the program made actual payments or how separately appearing crypto links relate to it.
